_comment: Retry-driven tester -> coder loop (#811). The coder works on a git branch; the tester runs the test suite. The tester's retry block sends a failed attempt back to the coder with the failure reason in extensions.test_feedback, up to max_retries times, then goes to escalate. An attempt also counts as failed when the coder changed no files (not diff_stats.files > 0). The coder runs on Claude Code and falls back to Codex on a backend error (rate limit, out of credits, timeout, unavailable). Start a run with initial_state {"repo": "owner/name", "branch": "develop", "description": "what to build"}. Edit the tester's command, the coder's branch/base and the profiles before importing.

tpl_retry_coder.name: Retry loop: coder
tpl_retry_coder.prompt_template:
<agent_prompt version="1">
  <role>{{ role }}</role>
  <task>{{ (description or 'Make the test suite pass.') | e }}</task>
  <rules>Commit your work on the current branch. The tester runs the test suite after you; it also fails the attempt when you changed no files.</rules>
{% if extensions.test_feedback is defined %}  <feedback>The previous attempt failed: {{ extensions.test_feedback | e }}</feedback>
{% endif %}</agent_prompt>

runtime_config.command: echo 'Tests still failing after every retry; see the run state verification_reason.' >&2

pipeline.name: Tester -> coder retry loop
pipeline.description: The coder works on a branch, the tester runs the suite; failures loop back to the coder with feedback up to max_retries, then escalate (#811).
